findings.text: the elif that reports review-missing for a stored record naming another head returns before _queued_review_fields runs, so a review queued for the current head after a repair still reads review-missing and names a dispatch the coordinator already made.

placed_at falls back to now when a queued pointer carries no readable queued_at, so the duty row publishes a queued_at stamp that is the read time while queue_admission.queued_placements withholds that request's position.
